description:
Clinical Research Associate (CRA II) – Oncology

São Paulo

Full-time | ✈️ Travel required

The Role

We are seeking a Clinical Research Associate (CRA II) with at least 1 year of on-site monitoring experience in oncology to support the successful delivery of clinical trials. In this role, you will be responsible for site monitoring, compliance, and data quality, playing a critical role in bringing innovative therapies to patients.

You will work closely with investigative sites and cross-functional project teams to ensure studies are conducted in accordance with GCP, ICH guidelines, regulatory requirements, and study protocols .

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visits in line with the contracted scope of work
  • Ensure compliance with GCP, ICH, regulatory requirements, and study protocols
  • Partner with site staff to support and track patient recruitment and enrollment strategies
  • Deliver protocol and study-specific training to site personnel
  • Assess site performance, identify quality risks, and escalate issues proactively
  • Monitor study progress, including regulatory documentation, enrollment, CRF completion, and query resolution
  • Ensure accurate and complete maintenance of TMF and ISF documentation
  • Document monitoring activities through detailed visit reports, follow-ups, and correspondence
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support overall study execution and timelines
  • Where applicable, support site-level recruitment planning and financial activities , including invoice tracking

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a health-related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Minimum 1 year of on-site monitoring experience , preferably in oncology
  • Strong working knowledge of GCP, ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements
  • Excellent communication, organisation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability and willingness to travel as required

Why apply?

  • Work on oncology-focused clinical trials with meaningful patient impact
  • Join a biotech-focused CRO environment known for agility and scientific alignment
  • Gain exposure to high-quality studies and collaborative project teams
  • Continue developing your CRA career within complex and innovative trials

title: Podcast Audio Editor
description:
Company Description

Sofia Health® is an online marketplace that connects clients with providers across a wide range of health and wellness services, offering everything from 1:1 sessions to wellness products. The platform empowers individuals to access both conventional and complementary care in one convenient location, giving them greater choice and control over their health journey. Providers can grow their practices by offering a variety of services and programs through Sofia Health. The company also partners with employers and government agencies, including VA Health Care Systems, to deliver accessible, integrative wellness programs. Sofia Health is dedicated to making wellness personalized, effective, and universally accessible.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Podcast Audio Editor. The Podcast Audio Editor will be responsible for editing podcast audio files, enhancing sound quality, implementing sound design, adding music, and ensuring overall quality control for each episode. The role involves working closely with the content team to maintain brand consistency and meet deadlines efficiently.


Responsibilities
  • Edit raw podcast audio into polished, broadcast-ready episodes
  • Remove filler words, false starts, redundancies, and off-topic tangents
  • Improve pacing, clarity, and flow without changing the speaker’s voice or intent
  • Restructure sections when needed based on how questions were answered
  • Insert intro/outro, sponsor reads, disclaimers, or updates when required
  • Follow embedded audio notes and written instructions carefully
  • Deliver clean final WAV/MP3 files on deadline
  • Produce 3–4 short clips per episode for marketing use
  • Support up to two rounds of edits per episode when requested


What We’re Looking For
  • Proven experience editing long-form podcasts (interview or narrative style)
  • Strong editorial judgment — you know what to cut and why
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow instructions precisely
  • Comfortable working with physician and expert-level conversations
  • Fast, reliable turnaround times
  • Clear, professional communication
  • Familiarity with tools like Descript, Adobe Audition, Pro Tools, Logic, or similar


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Audio Editing, including cleaning, trimming, and fine-tuning audio files
  • Experience with Sound Design and the ability to enhance audio with effects and background elements
  • Knowledge of Sound and Music production basics to seamlessly incorporate them into content
  • Strong Editing skills paired with attention to detail to maintain high-quality output
  • Familiarity with audio editing software such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar tools
  • Ability to work independently, communicate effectively with teams, and meet deadlines
  • Experience in podcast production is a plus
  • Background in audio engineering, media production, or a related field is beneficial

  • Willing and able to work in Angola
  • Bachelor's Degree as a minimum in relevant field including Finance, Math or Engineering;
    MBA and/or other professional qualifications are highly preferred
  • 4+ years of Demand Planning experience in a large organization
  • Strong understanding of supply chain management, logistics, and inventory / production planning
  • Proficiency in using demand planning and forecasting tools is necessary
  • Proficiency in using forecast accuracy KPIs
  • Strong experience with ERP and demand planning systems (e.G., SAP APO, Oracle Demantra, Kinaxis, Anaplan)
  • Advanced Excel and data analysis skills;
    experience with BI tools (e.G., Power BI, Tableau)Knowledge of statistical forecasting methods and demand modeling
  • Solid understanding of distribution networks, inventory management, and supply chain dynamics
  • Familiarity with S&OP processes and cross-functional planning
  • Proficiency in analyzing large sets of data and using data visualization tools to identify trends, patterns, and insight
  • Prior FMCG experience will be a plus
  • Ability to influence the decision makers
  • Highest standards of accuracy and precision
  • Articulate with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly-driven and self-motivated
  • Proven ability to work with ambiguity

CRFs

title: Fullstack Engineer (Python)
description:
About the Opportunity:

We are hiring Fullstack Engineer (Python). You will play a key role in building and maintaining integrations within Veriff’s ecosystem, contributing to high-quality, secure, and reliable data processing pipelines. This role involves working with multiple external providers, complex REST APIs, and integrating with both monolithic and microservices architectures.


Responsibilities:

  • Build complete onboarding integrations from external data provider APIs into Veriff’s internal workflows.
  • Implement data normalization and transformation logic.
  • Develop connector implementations following Veriff’s Connector Hub standards.
  • Ensure production-grade quality, security, and reliability.
  • Implement REST API integrations, authentication (OAuth, API keys, custom), data mapping, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  • Work on performance optimizations and rate limiting.
  • Collaborate with the internal Connector Hub team, providing feedback and suggesting improvements.
  • Work within existing monolithic and microservices architecture and integrate with RabbitMQ.


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of professional experience with Python.
  • Strong command of Python (async, error handling, data structures).
  • Significant hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, working with 8+ different providers .
  • Expertise in data parsing, mapping, and transformation (JSON/XML parsing and manipulation).
  • Experience with RabbitMQ or other message-queue systems.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including production API issues.
  • Fast learner with the ability to understand and adapt to new vendor APIs.
  • Ability to write clear, concise technical documentation.


Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with multi-provider integrations .
  • Domain knowledge in identity verification, KYC, or fintech .
  • Understanding of the Latin American or European markets .
